# cert-manager-crds

<!-- GENERATED by tooling/crdgen. Do not edit. -->

CustomResourceDefinitions for cert-manager (certificates, issuers, ACME orders and challenges).

CRDs are copied verbatim from [cert-manager/cert-manager](https://github.com/cert-manager/cert-manager)
at tag [`v1.21.2`](https://github.com/cert-manager/cert-manager/tree/v1.21.2) (commit `922a06aa49ee4bb802db268ef72a174af70edd32`),
path(s) `deploy/crds`, and rendered as regular Helm templates so that
`helm upgrade` updates them (Helm's own `crds/` directory never upgrades).

## Install

```sh
helm install cert-manager oci://ghcr.io/spnngl/charts/cert-manager-crds --version <version>
```

Chart `version` equals the upstream version it ships; `appVersion` is always the exact upstream version.
Installing requires Kubernetes >=1.25.0.

### Already have these CRDs?

If the CRDs were installed by the operator chart or `kubectl apply`, Helm refuses with
"rendered manifests contain a resource that already exists". Either let Helm adopt them:

```sh
helm install cert-manager oci://ghcr.io/spnngl/charts/cert-manager-crds --version <version> --take-ownership   # Helm >= 3.17
```

or, on older Helm, hand them over first (replace `<release>` and `<namespace>`):

```sh
kubectl annotate crd certificaterequests.cert-manager.io certificates.cert-manager.io challenges.acme.cert-manager.io clusterissuers.cert-manager.io issuers.cert-manager.io orders.acme.cert-manager.io \
  meta.helm.sh/release-name=<release> meta.helm.sh/release-namespace=<namespace> --overwrite
kubectl label crd certificaterequests.cert-manager.io certificates.cert-manager.io challenges.acme.cert-manager.io clusterissuers.cert-manager.io issuers.cert-manager.io orders.acme.cert-manager.io \
  app.kubernetes.io/managed-by=Helm --overwrite
```
